ITEM 1 | Pizza slice on plate's upper right, triangular wedge about 12 cm long, golden-orange melted cheese with browning spots on top, crust edge visible at the outer point, sits on a bed of tan breaded or crumbly base beneath | 130
ITEM 2 | Mixed green salad cluster upper left, dark red-purple leafy greens with curled edges, sliced cucumber rounds pale green with white flesh, diced bright red pieces (tomato or pepper), moist and glossy, spread about 9 cm across | 85
ITEM 3 | Caesar-style salad heap lower left, crisp pale yellow-green romaine leaves with white-cream dressing coating, scattered small flakes of pale grated hard cheese, wet sheen, piled about 11 cm across | 110
ITEM 4 | Sliced grilled-looking light meat pieces lower right, pale beige-white chunks about 3 to 4 cm each with slight browning at edges, dotted with green herb flecks and creamy white sauce drizzle, moist surface, sits beside salad | 95
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale dressing drizzle, thin white-green smear with herb flecks spread across lower right near meat and salad, glossy wet sheen | 12
